name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 1993 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK did not exist in 1993: every id here is a later mapping made by the study from the 1993 record, chiefly the CERT/CC advisories CA-93:01 to CA-93:19 (with CA-94:01 as a boundary record), press reports of the year's prosecutions, and Virus Bulletin and the CARO WILDList on the virus record. No ATT&CK group, software or campaign object covers a 1993 actor or tool. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_1993.md. Scores: 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred; no entry scores 100, because no 1993 source prints an id.
